          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "Leather is a sturdy material formed from animal hides. It is required to craft Armor, Saddles, or a Bellows. Raw Hides must be treated through several processes: soaking, scraping, preparing, and tanning to turn them into Leather.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "Raw Hide",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "To get started you will first need to obtain Raw Hide, which is dropped when slaughtering many different Animals. Different animals will drop different sizes of Raw Hide.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "Leather making will require several materials and tools. You will need: - Limewater - a solution of Flux in Water - Water - Tannin - an acidic solution made from the bark of some trees. - Raw Hides With all that on hand, you are ready to begin the leather working process.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "First, raw hides must be soaked to clean them and loosen unwanted material before processing. This can be done by sealing some Raw Hide in a Barrel of Limewater for at least eight hours.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "After soaking, Soaked Hides must be scraped which removes any excess material. In order to scrape hides, place the hide on the side of a Log. With a Knife, on each part of the hide and it will start to change texture.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "Once the hide is fully scraped, it can be broken to pick up a Scraped Hide.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "After scraping, Scraped Hides must be sealed in a Barrel of Water for at least eight hours, for one final cleaning before tanning.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/leather_making.json",
          "text": "Finally, Prepared Hides must be sealed in a Barrel of Tannin, which is an acidic chemical compound that helps to convert the hide to Leather. After another eight hours, you can remove the Leather from the barrel.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Leather Making",
          "item_ref_count": 10,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 8
        },
        {

          "text": "The building gadget makes building a large number of blocks all at once extremely easy! First, ensure the gadget has some energy. Second, Shift right-click a block in the world to specify the block to build with.",

          "text": "You can choose your Building Mode by holding the settings key. Each mode is described in its appropriate entry in this book. The default mode is Build to Me.           "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste.json",
          "text": "You can only have one structure stored on the gadget at a time. Placing it in the world will erased the stored information on the gadget. Be careful when pasting the structure, you only get one chance, exchange mode is recommended! If you attempt to cut a new area while data already exists, you'll be prompted to confirm. If you do this, the first set of data will be lost forever!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/cutpaste.json",
          "text": "All block-entity data will be moved along with the structure, including the contents of chests and block configurations. Much like the Copy Paste Gadget, you can modify the cut or paste positions with the appropriate settings menu option. See that chapter for details!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Cut Paste Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction.json",
          "text": "Destruction Gadget",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Destruction Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction.json",
          "text": "The destruction gadget makes clearing a large area very easy. Any blocks cleared will be voided!. First, open the settings menu and adjust the area. This area is with respect to the block (and block face) you are looking at. If you look at the top face of a block, 'up' will be relative to the player's screen.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Destruction Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction.json",
          "text": "Destruction Gadget",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Destruction Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction.json",
          "text": "Destroying an area, click the arrow to see diffent pictures!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Destruction Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/destruction.json",
          "text": "Once you're satisfied with the settings, right click on a block to void all the highlighted blocks. They will be removed from the world. You may undo this action if you make a mistake. It will not remove items from your inventory to undo, as the gadget is just returning the voided blocks to the world.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Destruction Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "The exchanging gadget can swap one set of blocks for another! It cannot, however, replace air blocks. Use a Building Gadget for that! First, ensure the gadget has some energy. Second, Shift right-click a block in the world to specify the block to exchange to.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "You can choose your Exchanging Mode by holding the settings key. Each mode is described in its appropriate entry in this book. The default mode is Surface. When looking at a block in the world, you'll see a ghostly image of the blocks that will be placed over top of existing blocks. If you're missing the required items or energy to place these blocks, they will have a red overlay. Right click to exchange the blocks as shown.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "Exchange Preview",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "Seeing a preview of what will be exchanged",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "When you right click, exchanging will begin. Items will be taken out of your inventory to be placed into the world, and any blocks you don't have the necessary item for will be skipped. Items for the removed blocks will be returned to you. Note: You can enchant this tool with silk touch. Without it grass will return dirt, etc.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/exchanginggadget.json",
          "text": "You can undo with the exchanging gadget, but you must have the necessary items. For example, if you exchanged grass into stone bricks, you must have grass in your inventory to undo this exchange. Don't forget to apply silk touch if desired!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Exchanging Gadget",
          "item_ref_count": 4,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_anchor",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_anchor.json",
          "text": "Anchor allows you to 'lock in' the block you're looking at, so you can freely move or look around. There is a hotkey for this, or you can access it from the settings menu. You can right click at any time to build the structure when it is anchored. Note: Changing range may not take effect until you remove and replace the anchor.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Anchor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_anchor",
          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_anchor.json",
          "text": "Anchor your render!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Anchor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "buildinggadgets2:buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_bindinv",

        {

          "text": "Binding to an inventory allows you to interact with that inventory to extract/insert items. First, enable 'bind inventory' mode in the settings menu of your gadget.         {

          "text": "Binding to a Chest!",

        {

          "source": "jar:buildinggadgets2-1.0.8.jar!assets/buildinggadgets2/patchouli_books/buildinggadgets2book/en_us/entries/mech_bindinv.json",
          "text": "You can also bind to an Applied Energistics 2 System by connecting to the wireless access point of that system. The gadget will have unlimited range, so no need to worry about range upgrades!",

          "label": "Bind Inventory",

          "text": "Torches can be made by heating sticks or stick bunches in a Firepit or other heating device.",

          "recipe_ref_count": 2,

          "text": "Torches last for 3 days, and then become Dead Torches, which may be relit by clicking them with a torch, or by using a fire starting tool on them. Sticks can also be clicked on torches to light them. Torches dropped in water turn into Wood Ash and Sticks.",

          "text": "Jack 'o Lanterns are the lit version of Carved Pumpkins, and last for 4.5 days, before reverting to carved pumpkins.",

          "label": "Light Sources",
          "item_ref_count": 7,

          "text": "Carved Pumpkins are made by clicking with Shears or a Knife on a fresh Pumpkin. Carved pumpkins do not rot, and can be worn on your head.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Light Sources",

          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/crops.json",
          "text": "Soul soil may be tilled to form Soul Farmland. Crops work a little differently when you are Beneath. There are five nutrients: Death, Destruction, Decay, Sorrow, and Flame. Nutrients are viewed by holding a hoe, but will not appear unless they have a value greater than zero.",

          "label": "Crops",
          "item_ref_count": 6,

        },
        {

          "text": "Crops have a preferred nutrient: Instead of consuming it, this is the nutrient they will add to over time. The crop will happily consume the other four nutrients in order to grow. Nether crops cannot die, but still need block light to grow.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Crops",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 7

          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/crops.json",
          "text": "The fertilizers are as follows: Sulfur: 20% decay, 10% flame Gunpowder: 60% Destruction, 10% Flame, 40% Death Ghast Tear: 30% Sorrow Blaze Powder: 20% Flame",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Crops",
          "item_ref_count": 6,

        },
        {

          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/crops.json",
          "text": "The fertilizers are also available in obtainable 'pure' forms from chest loot. Crafting these together yields Agonizing Fertilizer, which has them all in a neat package.",

          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/crops",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/crops.json",
          "text": "Crimson Roots (Decay) and Warped Roots (Destruction) are growable as crops. These are most useful as means of improving the nutrient quality of your soul farmland. Nether Wart (Death), found in fortresses, can also be grown as a crop.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Crops",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/crops",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/crops.json",
          "text": "The Gleamflower (Flame) can be grown as a crop, and also found in the world as a plant. It is useful as an infinite light source.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Crops",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/crops",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/crops.json",
          "text": "Ghost Peppers (Sorrow) are an edible vegetable that can be grown in the Beneath!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Crops",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/curious_blocks",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/curious_blocks.json",
          "text": "Curious Blocks",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Curious Blocks",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/curious_blocks",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/curious_blocks.json",
          "text": "Soul Clay",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.name",
          "label": "Curious Blocks",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/curious_blocks",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/curious_blocks.json",
          "text": "Soul Clay may be discovered in soul sand valleys. It is a source of regular clay.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Curious Blocks",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/curious_blocks",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/curious_blocks.json",
          "text": "Sulfur can be broken with a shovel. Be careful, though: iron-containing items (including steel) explode in contact with sulfur!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Curious Blocks",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/curious_blocks",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/curious_blocks.json",
          "text": "Cutting grass will yield you warped or crimson straw. This can be made into thatch, the normal way.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Curious Blocks",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/curious_blocks",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/curious_blocks.json",
          "text": "The blackstone aqueduct allows lava to be conducted at any distance.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Curious Blocks",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/curious_blocks",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/curious_blocks.json",
          "text": "Hellbricks are a building block that is also used for the Hellforge.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Curious Blocks",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/curious_blocks",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/curious_blocks.json",
          "text": "Blackstone bricks are made like regular bricks, and that includes needing to create the brick item.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Curious Blocks",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/hellforge",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/hellforge.json",
          "text": "The Hellforge",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "The Hellforge",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/hellforge",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/hellforge.json",
          "text": "The Hellforge is a gratuitously large forge, with high capacity for fuel, products, and heating. It is constructed from Hellbricks, Anthracite, and Pyroxenite Aqueducts.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "The Hellforge",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/hellforge",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/hellforge.json",
          "text": "The Hellforge requires lava to flow in aqueducts in its four corners, as well as 21 hellbricks. The 3x3 center must be filled with Anthracite piles, which then may be lit to start the forge.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "The Hellforge",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/hellforge",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/hellforge.json",
          "text": "The item slots of the Hellforge may contain fuel, or things to be smelted; there is no distinction. Be careful what you put in! There are also slots for melting things, as with the charcoal forge. The lava meter on the screen indicates temperature (as well as the visual movement of its items in world).",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "The Hellforge",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/hellforge",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/hellforge.json",
          "text": "The Hellforge",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "The Hellforge",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/hellforge",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/hellforge.json",
          "text": "The Hellforge is a gratuitously large forge, with high capacity for fuel, products, and heating. It is constructed from Hellbricks, Cursecoal, and Blackstone Aqueducts.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "The Hellforge",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/hellforge",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/hellforge.json",
          "text": "The Hellforge requires lava to flow in aqueducts in its four corners, as well as 21 hellbricks. The 3x3 center must be filled with Cursecoal piles, which then may be lit to start the forge.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "The Hellforge",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/hellforge",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/hellforge.json",
          "text": "The item slots of the Hellforge may contain fuel, or things to be smelted; there is no distinction. Be careful what you put in! There are also slots for melting things, as with the charcoal forge. The lava meter on the screen indicates temperature (as well as the visual movement of its items in world).",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "The Hellforge",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Ores and Minerals",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 9,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "The ores you can find Beneath are mostly similar to what you can find on the surface, but with a few changes. Consult the Ores in TFG category for exact details.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 9,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "The most common rock type found is Migmatite. This deep metamorphic rock contains a wide variety of ores you'd normally find in other rock types on the surface.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 9,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "In wetter areas, you may find Travertine. It is a sedimentary rock that can contain the same kind of ores as Migmatite.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 9,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Around the deepest level of the Beneath, the different rock types gradually all turn into Pyroxenite. This ultramafic igneous rock is extremely rich in ores, but this depth also comes with extreme heat, so be prepared!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 9,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Anthracite is a powerful fuel. It can be found in Migmatite in the upper half of the Beneath.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 9,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Ores and Minerals",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Beneath the overworld, you will still find ore veins to exploit. It is important to note that Netherrack does not collapse, like raw stone would. However, Blackstone, Nether Bricks, Cobblerack and miscellaneous other blocks do. Prospecting will still work Beneath the overworld.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Nether Gold",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.name",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Nether Gold replaces netherrack, and is common. Beneath lava, there is more gold, and richer.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Cursecoal is a powerful fuel. It replaces netherrack above level 80.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Sylvite replaces basalt at any level.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Nether Quartz",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.name",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Nether Quartz replaces netherrack at all levels, and is common.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Slimed Netherrack",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.name",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Slimed Netherrack occasionally replaces Netherrack above lava level.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "Dugout Canoes",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "The Dugout Canoe will likely be the first step on your aquatic journey! If you're in the copper age, you can probably build a canoe.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "You can put blocks or animals in the pilot seat, but be aware that there's no way to paddle the boat if you do this! It's most useful if you just want to send materials down a river on their own. A canoe has two seats, and is piloted from the rear. You need to hold a canoe paddle in order to move at full speed, and if two players are holding paddles, you can go even faster.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "To build a Dugout Canoe, place 3 stripped logs in a row, horizontally, and cut off the tops with a saw. Then, carve out the canoe shape with an axe. Finally, light the inside of the canoe on fire to hollow out the hull. It will take the same amount of time as a pit kiln to complete the hollowing process.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "Carving out a Dugout Canoe requires a softer wood, and as a result, only some logs are workable: Douglas Fir Pine Palm Spruce Sequoia Kapok Mangrove White Cedar Willow",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "Just a Log",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.name",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "The first step in making a Dugout Canoe.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "Weird Slabs",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.name",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "text": "So, you've reached the Bronze Age and you want an upgrade? Well, the rowboat is for you. It has three seats, so it can hold 3 players, or up to 2 animals, including horses!           "label": "Rowboats",

          "recipe_ref_count": 1,

          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/rowboat.json",
          "text": "In the rowboat, unlike other boats, you'll be sitting backwards when you're piloting the boat. It gives you a mechanical advantage so you can really put your back into those oars! You can, of course, pilot it in first-person, but if you may find it more intuitive in third-person facing yourself.",

          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/crops.json",
          "text": "Soul soil may be tilled to form Soul Farmland. Crops work a little differently when you are Beneath. There are five nutrients: Death, Destruction, Decay, Sorrow, and Flame. Nutrients are viewed by holding a hoe, but will not appear unless they have a value greater than zero.",

          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/crops.json",
          "text": "Crops have a preferred nutrient: Instead of consuming it, this is the nutrient they will add to over time. The crop will happily consume the other four nutrients in order to grow. Nether crops cannot die, but still need block light to grow.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Crops",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/crops",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/crops.json",
          "text": "The fertilizers are as follows: Sulfur: 20% decay, 10% flame Gunpowder: 60% Destruction, 10% Flame, 40% Death Ghast Tear: 30% Sorrow Blaze Powder: 20% Flame",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Crops",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/crops",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/crops.json",
          "text": "The fertilizers are also available in obtainable 'pure' forms from chest loot. Crafting these together yields Agonizing Fertilizer, which has them all in a neat package.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Crops",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/crops",
          "source": "jar:beneath-1.20.1-1.0.6.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/crops.json",
          "text": "Crimson Roots (Decay) and Warped Roots (Destruction) are growable as crops. These are most useful as means of improving the nutrient quality of your soul farmland. Nether Wart (Death), found in fortresses, can also be grown as a crop.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Crops",

          "text": "The Gleamflower (Flame) can be grown as a crop, and also found in the world as a plant. It is useful as an infinite light source.",

          "label": "Crops",
          "item_ref_count": 6,

          "text": "The Hellforge is a gratuitously large forge, with high capacity for fuel, products, and heating. It is constructed from Hellbricks, Anthracite, and Pyroxenite Aqueducts.",

          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "The ores you can find Beneath are mostly similar to what you can find on the surface, but with a few changes. Consult the Ores in TFG category for exact details.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 9,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "The most common rock type found is Migmatite. This deep metamorphic rock contains a wide variety of ores you'd normally find in other rock types on the surface.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 9,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "In wetter areas, you may find Travertine. It is a sedimentary rock that can contain the same kind of ores as Migmatite.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 9,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Around the deepest level of the Beneath, the different rock types gradually all turn into Pyroxenite. This ultramafic igneous rock is extremely rich in ores, but this depth also comes with extreme heat, so be prepared!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 9,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals.json",
          "text": "Anthracite is a powerful fuel. It can be found in Migmatite in the upper half of the Beneath.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 9,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "text": "Ores and Minerals",

        {

          "text": "Beneath the overworld, you will still find ore veins to exploit. It is important to note that Netherrack does not collapse, like raw stone would. However, Blackstone, Nether Bricks, Cobblerack and miscellaneous other blocks do. Prospecting will still work Beneath the overworld.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 6
        },
        {

          "text": "Nether Gold",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.name",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",

        {

          "text": "Nether Gold replaces netherrack, and is common. Beneath lava, there is more gold, and richer.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/beneath/ores_and_minerals",

          "text": "Cursecoal is a powerful fuel. It replaces netherrack above level 80.",

          "label": "Ores and Minerals",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "Dugout Canoes",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "The Dugout Canoe will likely be the first step on your aquatic journey! If you're in the copper age, you can probably build a canoe.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "You can put blocks or animals in the pilot seat, but be aware that there's no way to paddle the boat if you do this! It's most useful if you just want to send materials down a river on their own. A canoe has two seats, and is piloted from the rear. You need to hold a canoe paddle in order to move at full speed, and if two players are holding paddles, you can go even faster.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "To build a Dugout Canoe, place 3 stripped logs in a row, horizontally, and cut off the tops with a saw. Then, carve out the canoe shape with an axe. Finally, light the inside of the canoe on fire to hollow out the hull. It will take the same amount of time as a pit kiln to complete the hollowing process.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "Carving out a Dugout Canoe requires a softer wood, and as a result, only some logs are workable: Douglas Fir Pine Palm Spruce Sequoia Kapok Mangrove White Cedar Willow",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "Just a Log",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.name",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {

          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "The first step in making a Dugout Canoe.",

          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {

          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "Weird Slabs",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.name",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {

          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe",

          "text": "The top of the log has been removed using a saw.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "A Strange Sculpture",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.name",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe",
          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "A fully carved Dugout Canoe, ready for hollowing out the hull.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "source": "jar:FirmaCivilization-1.20.1-1.0.9.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/canoe.json",
          "text": "Don't forget to craft a paddle or two!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.text",
          "label": "Dugout Canoes",
          "item_ref_count": 7,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 9
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/rowboat",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/rowboat.json",
          "text": "So, you've reached the Bronze Age and you want an upgrade? Well, the rowboat is for you. It has three seats, so it can hold 3 players, or up to 2 animals, including horses! As always, you can also replace seats (except for the pilot seat) with containers of your choosing. You can also place two additional containers at the stern.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Rowboats",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 10
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/rowboat",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmaciv/rowboat.json",
          "text": "In the rowboat, unlike other boats, you'll be sitting backwards when you're piloting the boat. It gives you a mechanical advantage so you can really put your back into those oars! You can, of course, pilot it in first-person, but if you may find it more intuitive in third-person facing yourself.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Rowboats",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 10
        }

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/arborfirmacraft/tree_tapping.json",
          "text": "Some types of trees can be tapped for useful fluids. These trees can either produce sugary saps which can be concentrated into syrup and used as a sweetener, Latex which can be processed into rubber, or Pitch which can be processed into rosin, a wax substitute.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Tapping Trees",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 4
        },
        {

          "text": "Tapping a Maple Tree",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Tapping Trees",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "count": 4
        },
        {

          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/arborfirmacraft/tree_tapping",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/arborfirmacraft/tree_tapping.json",
          "text": "Three things are required to tap a tree: the tree itself, a tree tap, which must forged from a Copper Ingot and placed in the middle of a trunk at least three blocks tall, and a barrel, which must be placed directly below the tap facing upward.           "label": "Tapping Trees",
          "item_ref_count": 6,

        {

          "text": "Some types of trees can be tapped for useful fluids. By default, Maples and Birches can be tapped for sugary saps, and Rubber Figs and Hevea can be tapped for latex. Saps can be concentrated into syrup and used as a sweetener, while latex can be processed into rubber.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Tapping Trees",
          "item_ref_count": 5,

        {

          "text": "Tapping a Maple Tree",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Tapping Trees",
          "item_ref_count": 5,

        },
        {

          "text": "Three things are required to tap a tree: the tree itself, a tree tap, which must forged from wrought iron and placed in the middle of a trunk at least three blocks tall, and a barrel, which must be placed directly below the tap facing upward. If the conditions are right, your barrel will immediately begin to fill with sap.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Tapping Trees",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "source": "jar:afc-1.0.20-1.20.1.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/arborfirmacraft/tree_tapping.json",
          "text": "Not all trees produce all of the time. Maple and Birch trees produce sap in spring at temperatures between -4°C and 6°C, or around when the snow is beginning to melt. Hevea trees produce latex only when the temperature is above 22°C. Rubber Figs produce latex at 12°C or above, but produce more slowly than Hevea. Latitude, altitude, time of the year, and the time of day all impact the temperature, and thus the flow of sap.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",

          "text": "Each quest branch representing major mods in TerraFirmaGreg, with tips to make the most out of them. None of these quests are necessary for progression, although some may be locked behind main questline tasks.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Dear God that's a lot of branches...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Tips and Tricks be here!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Firmalife is a mod all about extending the agricultural and gastronomic experience in TerraFirmaCraft, with touches of miscellaneous features. Includes things such as decorations, more preservation methods, new foods, bees and a plethora of useful gadgets!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Thrive in TerraFirmaCraft",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "ArborFirmaCraft is a mod that adds multiple new trees to TFG: some are variants of existing TFC trees, such as Ancient Kapok, while others are completely new, such as the Baobab and Hevea. Some of the plank and log textures of these trees may remind you of vanilla tree colors...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "This section will go over Tree Tapping.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "As a bonus, all ArborFirmaCraft woods are compatible with FirmaLife, and Firma:Civ, we made sure of it!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "tfc:field_guide tfc:arborfirmacraft/tapping_index",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Harvesting the Life-blood of Trees",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Deep, DEEP underground, past the Bedrock, you'll find The Beneath, a complex network of huge caves filled with dangers and strange flora and fauna. While The Beneath is completely optional, it contains a lot of resources as well as some quality of life improvements.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "tfc:field_guide tfc:beneath/beneath",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Journey to the Center of the Earth",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "The Beneath",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "TerraFirmaCraft is one of the main mods in TerraFirmaGreg. This branch mostly focuses on some of its survival features and other Add-Ons the modpack has, such as Aged Alcohol and Canes.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "The other two thirds of the modpack's name",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "TerraFirmaCraft Addons",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "To begin tapping trees, you'll need to forge a Tree Tap from working Copper Ingots on an Anvil.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "The process of tapping requires finding a suitable tree, a dedicated Tapping Index in the ArborFirmaCraft Field Guide section will tell you how to find these trees. There's also the Tapping Trees entry, which can be used to learn how to actually tap them.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "tfc:field_guide tfc:arborfirmacraft/tree_tapping",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Now with less jank!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "one_completed",

          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Utilizing the Vacuum Chamber and some additional heating, you can process Latex from various trees into Raw Rubber Pulp through a specific process. You can then smelt together 3 Raw Rubber Pulp with a bit of Sulfur Dust in an Alloy Smelter to create Rubber Ingots, perfect for insulating cables and very much necessary to advance in the Voltaic Age and beyond...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Tip: As you progress, there will be several ways to make this process cheaper and easier. Keep checking EMI! You'll be using Rubber for a long time, so it's well worth automating.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Insulate them cables",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Rubber Ingot",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Sticky Resin can be utilized as slime balls in some recipes. It is also key in the production of Resin Circuits and Resistors, which you'll need a fair bit of to advance into the Low Voltage age.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "To make sticky resin, you need to boil either Latex or Conifer Pitch in a Vat mixed with Wood Ash.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "No, it's not Rosin",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Sticky Resin",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Latex Trees can be found in temperate areas of the world that receive large amounts of rainfall. It can be tapped to obtain Latex, used to create both Sticky Resin, and Vulcanized Latex. The latter is used to produce Rubber and Rubber Gloves, which protect you from poisonous materials on contact.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "To complete this quest, you need to look at a block that has the tag #tfg:latex_logs. You can use EMI to learn which blocks have this tag by searching with that hashtag.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "key": "quest-snbt",

        },
        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Latex Trees",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Syrup Trees can be found in temperate areas of the world that receive moderate amounts of rainfall. It can be tapped to obtain Syrup. Syrup can be used to create Tree Sugars, an alternative sugar among other uses.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "To complete this quest, you need to look at a block that has the tag #tfg:syrup_logs. You can use EMI to learn which blocks have this tag.",

          "label": "queststfc_tips",

        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Tree Sugar is a sugar substitute, mostly used as a food ingredient.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "To make it, you'll need to boil Tree Sap to get Concentrated Sap, then boil it again to get Syrup. Finally, use a workbench to turn a Bucket of Syrup into Tree sugar.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Keep in mind that all these boiling processes require a stick in the Vat or pot.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",

          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "If you have advanced to the MV age, you can make a Refrigerator, consuming power in exchange for the best universal food preservation trait for all food items. This includes raw and cooked food, and combined foods like sandwiches.",
